results.original_text: As a site editor, I want to have pretty good control over how the article, so that articles are visually appealing.
results.final_text:
User Story:
As a site editor, I want to have comprehensive control over the article's formatting and layout so that I can ensure each article is visually appealing and engaging for readers.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Editors must be able to customize text styles (font, size, color) with a user-friendly interface, achieving at least a 90% usability satisfaction rating.
- The platform should allow for the addition of multimedia elements (images, videos) with a success rate of ≥95% for uploads and placements.
- Articles should render correctly across all major browsers and devices, maintaining visual integrity in 100% of tests conducted.

Test Outline:
- Conduct usability testing sessions with editors to evaluate the effectiveness of the formatting tools.
- Test the upload process for multimedia elements to ensure they are integrated without errors.
- Perform cross-browser compatibility testing to confirm that articles display consistently on different platforms.

history.text:
User Story:
As a site editor, I want to have comprehensive control over article formatting and layout so that I can ensure each article is visually appealing and engaging for readers.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The editor must be able to customize text styles, images, and layout elements with a user-friendly interface, achieving at least an 85% user satisfaction rating.
- Articles should maintain a consistent visual design across different devices, with ≥95% compliance to the established style guide.
- The system should allow for real-time previews of changes, updating within 2 seconds for immediate feedback.

Test Outline:
- Conduct usability testing to assess editor satisfaction with the formatting tools and options.
- Review articles across multiple devices to confirm adherence to the style guide.
- Measure the responsiveness of the real-time preview feature during article edits.

history.text:
User Story:
As a site editor, I want to have robust control over the layout and formatting of articles so that I can ensure they are visually appealing and engaging for readers.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Editors must be able to customize article layouts using predefined templates, with at least 5 templates available.
- The formatting tools should allow for adjustments in font size, color, and spacing, ensuring changes can be previewed in real-time.
- At least 90% of articles should achieve a reader satisfaction score of 4 out of 5 or higher regarding visual appeal after implementation.

Test Outline:
- Review the usability of the article formatting tools through editor feedback sessions.
- Conduct A/B testing on articles with and without custom formatting to assess reader engagement and satisfaction.
- Analyze satisfaction survey results to confirm the desired score is met for visual appeal.

results.original_text: I want a search bar on the top of the page.
results.final_text:
User Story:
As a website visitor, I want a prominently placed search bar at the top of the page so that I can quickly locate content and navigate the site more efficiently.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The search bar should be visible on all pages within 2 seconds of loading, ensuring immediate accessibility.
- Users should be able to initiate a search with a single click or keystroke, with a success rate of 95% in finding desired content.
- The search functionality should support autocomplete suggestions, displaying at least 5 relevant options based on user input.

Test Outline:
- Measure the loading time of the search bar across different devices and browsers to confirm visibility within the specified time.
- Analyze user interactions to verify the ease of use and effectiveness of the search bar in retrieving information.
- Test the autocomplete feature to ensure it provides relevant suggestions based on various search terms.

User Story:
As a website visitor, I want a search bar prominently positioned at the top of the page so that I can quickly access and navigate to the content I am looking for without unnecessary scrolling.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The search bar should be visible on all pages and load within 2 seconds.
- It must allow users to perform searches that return relevant results with ≥85% accuracy.
- The search functionality should be accessible on both desktop and mobile devices, ensuring a responsive design.

Test Outline:
- Verify the visibility and loading time of the search bar on multiple page types.
- Conduct usability testing to measure the accuracy and relevance of search results derived from the search bar.
- Test the responsiveness of the search bar on various screen sizes to confirm accessibility.
